privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: This page explains what data Shelfy collects, why, and what rights you have over it.
privacy.controller_body: This Shelfy instance is operated by {{controller}}, who acts as the data controller for your personal data under the GDPR. Contact: {{email}}.
privacy.data_intro: To run your account, we collect:
privacy.data_account: Account: email address, username, password (hashed), optional display name and bio.
privacy.data_steam: Steam integration (optional): Steam ID, display name, avatar, and the game titles imported into your library.
privacy.data_activity: Activity: your collection (statuses, ratings, personal notes), your awards, the people you follow.
privacy.data_technical: Technical: your IP address in the server's access logs, for security purposes.
privacy.purposes_body: This data is processed to perform the contract that binds you to this service (providing your account and its features) and, for the logged IP address, on the basis of the operator's legitimate interest in keeping the service secure.
privacy.retention_body: Your account data is kept for as long as your account exists. Expired authentication tokens are purged automatically. Server access logs are kept under a bounded rotation set by the operator.
privacy.processors_intro: Some features rely on third-party services:
privacy.processors_catalogs: TMDB, IGDB and the Steam Web API: used only to search their public catalogs; no personal data about you is sent to them.
privacy.processors_mail: Our transactional email provider (SMTP): processes your email address to send account verification and password reset emails.
privacy.federation_body: This instance is federated: it exchanges data with other Shelfy instances and with Fediverse servers such as Mastodon, using the ActivityPub protocol. With a public profile, your username, display name, bio, avatar and shelf activity (additions, ratings, reviews, lists, versus pools, comments and likes) are sent to the servers of the people who follow you and the people you mention, and anyone can read them through those servers. A private profile never leaves this instance. Those servers are run by other operators, who are responsible for what they do with the copies they receive.
privacy.federation_deletion: When you edit or delete something, or delete your account, this instance asks those servers to update or remove their copy. Most servers respect this, but because they are independent, the removal cannot be guaranteed. A server that is offline for several days may also miss the request.
privacy.no_tracking_body: Shelfy does not use any analytics or advertising trackers. The only cookie in use is a technical cookie required for authentication (refresh token), which does not require consent under ePrivacy rules.
privacy.rights_body: Under the GDPR, you have the right to access, rectify, erase, port and object to the processing of your data. You can: edit your profile and download a copy of your data from the Settings page; permanently delete your account and all associated data from the Settings page; or contact us at {{email}} for any other request.
privacy.complaint_body: You can lodge a complaint with the competent supervisory authority if you believe your rights are not being respected: {{jurisdiction}}.

terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.intro: By creating an account on this Shelfy instance, you agree to the following terms.
terms.service_body: Shelfy is a personal tracker for movies, TV shows, video games, anime, manga and webtoons. Catalog data comes from third-party providers (TMDB, IGDB, AniList, Steam) and is provided for reference only.
terms.account_body: You're responsible for keeping your credentials confidential and for the accuracy of the information you provide. You must meet the legal age required in your jurisdiction to create an account.
terms.content_body: Content you add to your collection (notes, ratings) remains yours. Don't use the service for unlawful purposes or to disrupt its operation.
terms.availability_body: The service is provided "as is", without any guarantee of continuous availability, by the operator of this instance.
terms.termination_body: You can delete your account at any time from the Settings page. The operator may suspend an account in case of abusive use.
terms.contact_body: For any question about these terms, contact {{email}}.
